title: Visible button in lockscreen to turn off monitors
line: The lock screen now has a "Turn Off Screens" button next to Sleep and Switch User.
explanation: The only way to turn off the screens while locked was the Escape key, handled in the greeter's C++ event filter; the lock screen QML had no access to DPMS, so it couldn't offer a visible button. The greeter now keeps one KScreen::Dpms object and exposes canTurnOffScreens and turnOffScreens() on the LockscreenState QML singleton (Escape uses the same code). The lock screen adds a "Turn Off Screens" action button, shown only when DPMS is supported, that hides the prompt, clears the password and turns the screens off.

commits.message:
greeter: let the lock screen turn off the screens

Only the Escape key could turn off the screens from the lock screen, so
the QML had no way to offer a visible button for it. LockscreenState now
exposes canTurnOffScreens and turnOffScreens(), shared with Escape.

BUG: 427990

lockscreen: add a button to turn off the screens

Turning off the screens from the lock screen was only possible with the
Escape key, which is hard to discover. Add a "Turn Off Screens" button
next to Sleep and Switch User that hides the prompt and turns them off.

BUG: 427990

patches.diff:
From 8af4fb7548e9c02e1b7b9a5d13fd51a970ffe838 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 18:31:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: add a button to turn off the screens

Turning off the screens from the lock screen was only possible with the
Escape key, which is hard to discover. Add a "Turn Off Screens" button
next to Sleep and Switch User that hides the prompt and turns them off.

BUG: 427990
---
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml | 11 +++++++++++
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..67fdbd57bd 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -406,6 +406,17 @@ Item {
                 }
 
                 actionItems: [
+                    ActionButton {
+                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter | Qt.AlignTop
+                        text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Turn Off &Screens")
+                        icon.name: "monitor-symbolic"
+                        onClicked: {
+                            lockScreenRoot.uiVisible = false;
+                            root.clearPassword();
+                            ScreenLocker.LockscreenState.turnOffScreens();
+                        }
+                        visible: ScreenLocker.LockscreenState.canTurnOffScreens
+                    },
                     ActionButton {
                         Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter | Qt.AlignTop
                         text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Slee&p")
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Lock screen on master: only Switch User under the password field; the screens can only be turned off with the Escape key.
With the fix: a "Turn Off Screens" button next to Switch User. Clicking it turned the screen off (DPMS off, black frame); moving the mouse brought it back with the prompt.
